properties.description: As built (2026-09-17): a Constraint's limit carries limit_basis (measured | computed | asserted), limit_source (the tool, artifact or person it came from) and limit_measured_at; a contribution on CONSTRAINS carries source beside its basis and measured_at, stored only when there is a number for it to describe; a TemporalFact carries source. quantity_without_source names a limit with no limit_source and a contribution with a number and no source — an asserted number that names who asserted it is an answer, and the detector is silent on a design with no numeric limit. quantity_check_without_executable_form names a Verification that VERIFIES a Constraint with a limit and has no incoming IMPLEMENTS from an Artifact. budget_report reports limit_basis, limit_source and the unsourced contributors beside the total, which still includes them. The partnership contract is stated on the constrains tool: design the budget here, measure it in the partner tool, write the number back with basis measured and source naming the tool. Built after the unit-system capability, which it depends on.
properties.name: A quantity carries its provenance (measured, computed, asserted-by) and an unsourced one is named
